postconditions.expression: output == 'Impossible' or (isinstance(output, str) and len(output.split()) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output.split()))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Impossible', it is a single string 'Impossible'. Otherwise, it is a pair of integers representing the maximum profit and the minimum total cost of the chosen roads that yields the maximum profit.
